title: The Charter Street basement house and rehearsals
summary: Laine lived at about 2405 Charter near Mandeville in a basement house where the kids rehearsed.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Where were you living in those days? On Charter Street. Charter Street? What number? Do you remember? 24, 2405, wasn't it, Charter?
Yeah, next to the corner of Manneville. Right.
It was a basement house. Mm-hmm. I lived in there for years and years. We used to rehearse it in the basement.
All the kids get that in the basement. Yeah.
